settings.heading: Not veterinary advice. Fixed or refunded if a file fails.
settings.text: Every Mavilo Pet Co. guide is general education for pet parents, not a substitute for your veterinarian. All guides are instant PDF downloads; nothing is shipped. If your file won't open or doesn't match the listing, contact us within 30 days and we'll fix it or refund you.
settings.box_heading: Have a question about your pet's health?
settings.box_text: Please contact your veterinarian. For download or file problems, have your order number ready and contact support.
